documents.population: Non-JUPAS Year 1 applicants with international qualifications (direct application via eAdmission)
documents.notes: 'Application Procedures and Admission Process' (Non-JUPAS Year 1). Predicted results for IB / GCE A-level come from the school; confidential documents such as a predicted score report or reference letter go through the 'Academic Referee' section, but the page does not say a reference is required, so none is drafted. Admitted students have credentials sent directly by the awarding institution (verification stage, not drafted). The page states no academic year.

items.quote: or post-secondary qualifications (e.g. Associate Degree, Higher Diploma), you must apply directly to PolyU via our eAdmission
Applicants are required to upload scanned copies of the academic certificate(s)/ transcript(s) for qualifications as claimed in their application
If these documents are not in English or Chinese, you are required to provide official translated documents in English; otherwise, your application may not be considered.
items.condition: the documents are not in English or Chinese
